name: @crombolo/cli
description: The crombolo command line: scaffolding a site, schema, views, domains, content transfer and upgrades.
author: Crombolo

assets.description: the stylesheets and scripts beside the components

bundle.description: bundles: install, check, and purge their tables

components.description: the components in components/: check, list, new

content.description: move content between environments as bundles, and publish it

domains.description: the hostnames this site answers on (domains.toml)

import.description: replace this site with a whole-site file; import an Umbraco backup

maintenance.description: pause and resume editors' saves, cluster-wide

remote.description: the remotes this site pulls from and pushes to (remotes.toml)

types.description: schema-as-code: the content types, data types and languages in schema/

upgrade.description: framework migrations: check, plan, apply, ledger
